report.name: THENGA
report.site_is: A one-page brand-concept website for THENGA, which its page description calls 'a premium coconut-water concept rooted in the tropical beauty of Kerala'. The repo's REFERENCE-NOTES.md says the flavour range, packaging and copy are a creative brand concept and that 'The site explores flavours and does not pretend to take orders.'; IMAGE-CREDITS.md says 'Brand name and flavour identities are conceptual.'

report.name: Sedile
report.site_is: A concept online showroom and demo store for office chairs under the invented brand 'sedile.'. The page description calls it 'a calm digital showroom for office chairs. Explore in 3D and find the chair that fits your work style.', and the README (title 'Sedile — Premium 3D Chair Finder') says: 'A white, editorial furniture showroom where every chair is a real, slowly rotating 3D object.' It is built with React and three.js. All 16 chairs are drawn in real time from 3D models that are generated in code (README: 'No 3D models were supplied, so all 13 chair families are modelled in code'). The site has a four-question Chair Finder, a filterable catalogue, product pages with a 3D viewer and live colour/base/configuration options, a cart drawer, a wishlist and a demo checkout, plus collections, designers, about, journal and support pages. The footer states 'Demo storefront — no real orders are processed.'
report.tagline_verbatim: Explore our collection and find the chair that fits your work style.

report.name: VYRN
report.site_is: An editorial fashion storefront ('Editorial fashion storefront', README) for VYRN, a label of 'Modern essentials'. The home page runs a sequence of animated editorial sections: an opening logo sequence, the hero, categories, VYRN Studio, an editorial statement, a collection carousel, the Drop 07 product grid and a 'future essentials' campaign. The site also has a filterable collection page, product pages with size selection, a bag saved in a database, a journal, about and information pages, and a checkout. Payments are switched off. The site's terms call it 'a private preview of the VYRN storefront and creative direction', and the README says it is 'a private creative and shopping-flow preview, not an operational live merchant.' It is a Vinext/Cloudflare Worker app with a D1 database and is not hosted anywhere yet.
